title: Semi-Inducibility of some small graphs
summary: Let $H$ be a fixed graph whose edges are colored red and blue and let $β\in [0,1]$. Let $I(H, β)$ be the (asymptotically normalized) maximum number of copies of $H$ in a large red/blue edge-colored complete graph $G$, where the density of red edges in $G$ is $β$. This refines the problem of determining the semi-inducibility of $H$, which is itself a generalization of the classical question of determining the inducibility of $H$.
